brief:
Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, directors of the award-winning documentary NAZA on Israel's systemic mass killing of Palestinians in Gaza, defended their findings at the film's New York City premiere, The Guardian reported. The filmmakers faced threats from Israeli officials over the documentary's allegations.

Abraham and Szor addressed the threats publicly during the screening, standing by the documentary's investigation into Israel's conduct in Gaza. NAZA has received recognition despite the political pressure surrounding its release and exhibition.
